start.title: Synowie Adama
start.text:
Otwierasz oczy jako pierworodny Adama i Ewy.
Drugi syn, Abel, rodzi się po tobie.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Live as the firstborn son of Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve gave birth to Cain, and then to his brother Abel.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Be born before Adam and Eve
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Adam and Eve came first; Cain was their son.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Grow up as an only child
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain had a brother, Abel.

fields.title: Twoja Praca
fields.text:
Lata mijają. Każdy brat znajduje swoje zajęcie.
Jakie jest twoje?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Work the ground as a tiller of the soil
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:2 — Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Keep flocks of sheep like Abel
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Abel kept flocks; Cain worked the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Refuse to work at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain worked the ground.

abel_pasture.title: Praca Twojego Brata
abel_pasture.text:
Widzisz Abla po drugiej stronie pola.
Co on robi?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] See Abel keeping flocks of sheep
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:2 — Abel kept flocks.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] See Abel tilling the ground beside you
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Abel kept flocks, not that he tilled the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] See Abel fishing at the river
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis does not describe Abel fishing.

offerings.title: Przed Ołtarzem
offerings.text:
Nadchodzi czas, aby złożyć ofiarę Panu.
Co przyniesiesz?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bring some of the fruits of the soil as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:3 — Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bring a firstborn lamb from your flock
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Abel brought a lamb; Cain brought fruits of the soil.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bring nothing at all
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain did bring an offering, though not the best.

accepted.title: Wzgląd Pana
accepted.text:
Czekasz, gdy Pan patrzy na dwie ofiary.
Co się dzieje?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] The Lord looks with favor on Abel and his offering, but not on yours
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:4-5 — The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering, but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] The Lord favors both offerings equally
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the Lord favored Abel's offering, not both.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] The Lord accepts your offering and rejects Abel's
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the opposite — the Lord favored Abel's offering.

anger.title: Twoja Twarz Pochmurnieje
anger.text:
Ofiara się kończy. Coś w tobie narasta.
Jak reagujesz?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Become very angry, your face downcast
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:5 — Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Rejoice with Abel over his accepted offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain became angry, not that he rejoiced.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Bring a better offering the very next day
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis does not describe Cain bringing a second offering.

warning.title: Grzech Czai Się u Drzwi
warning.text:
Pan mówi do ciebie.
Co On mówi?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] 'Sin is crouching at your door — but you must rule over it'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:6-7 — The Lord warned Cain that sin was crouching at his door and he must rule over it.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] 'Bring a lamb instead of grain'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis does not record the Lord telling Cain to bring a lamb.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Nothing — the Lord is silent
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says the Lord did speak to Cain about sin at the door.

invitation.title: Mówisz do Swojego Brata
invitation.text:
Abel podchodzi blisko, ufny.
Co mówisz?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Say to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:8 — Cain said to Abel, 'Let's go out to the field.'

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Invite Abel to worship at the altar together
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain led Abel out to the field, not to the altar.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Send Abel away and never speak to him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain called Abel to the field, not that he sent him away.

field.title: Na polu
field.text:
Ty i Abel jesteście sami na otwartym polu.
Co robisz?

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Attack Abel your brother and kill him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:8 — Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Argue with Abel and then forgive him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain killed Abel; he did not forgive him.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Walk home without touching him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain killed Abel in the field.

confrontation.title: „Gdzie jest twój brat?”
confrontation.text:
Głos Pana cię odnajduje.
„Gdzie jest twój brat Abel?”

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Answer: 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis 4:9 — Cain replied, 'I don't know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Confess plainly: 'I have killed him'
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain denied knowing; he did not confess plainly.

choices.text: [TODO:pl] Stay silent before the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:pl] Genesis says Cain answered the Lord; he did not stay silent.

wanderer.title: Niespokojny wędrowiec
wanderer.text:
Pan naznacza cię dla twojej ochrony.
Wyruszasz w wędrówkę na wschód od Edenu, do ziemi Nod.
